_note: The run-state-keyed pair (§4.1 v5, kogaki#891). This capture sits in a
directory that ALREADY holds `terrain-dynamic.run-declaration.json` for a
different run, and its options match NEITHER that declaration NOR the
fixture registry — so it is admitted only when the sibling is resolved
from the capture's own filename. Under the gate_id-only lookup it resolves
the other run's declaration and reports CAPTURE_PAYLOAD_OPTIONS_MISMATCH,
which is the discrimination: two run states in one workspace is exactly
when the wrong declaration is least distinguishable from the right one.
